data_dictionary.indicator_name: Low-income population share in 500 m catchment (CT area-weighted estimate)
data_dictionary.definition: sum_t(area(buffer intersect CT_t)/area(CT_t) * LIM_AT_count_t) / sum_t(area(buffer intersect CT_t)/area(CT_t) * total_population_t)
data_dictionary.spatial_scope: 500 m continuous corridor buffer; CT area weighting; corridor 01 trial geometry only
data_dictionary.population_scope: LIM-AT private-household numerator / all Census residents denominator; custom proxy, not official prevalence
data_dictionary.technology_dependence: none in Census counts; catchment assumptions apply
data_dictionary.potential_overlap: population coverage; other resident equity indicators
data_dictionary.notes: User replaced PPI with an independent LIM-AT share. Main numerator is CT Census characteristic 326; denominator is characteristic 1 (all residents). Characteristic 321 provides a separate private-household-universe comparator. CT and DA populations are spatial estimates under uniform within-area density. DA 35202414 has confidentiality suppression; its missing count is preserved and the complete DA share is unavailable. User approved a consistent CT area-weighting policy after this finding. This proxy measures resident concentration, not benefits or a Palma ratio. Income reference year is 2020, Census geography/population are 2021; trial road geometry is from 2026. Only corridor 01 has a pilot; remaining 23 and geographic review are pending. Population midpoint 32679.5 is a denominator-only stress scenario; it is not an area-weighted estimate. No source value is imputed. v0.4: Batch has 17 current-road proxies and 15 complete provisional CT estimates. Seven alignments remain unresolved; corridors 3 and 21 intersect positive-population CTs with suppressed LIM counts (5350205.00 and 5350006.00). Census suppression is not imputed. All station, alignment and cartographic-frame reviews remain pending.

indicator_admission.indicator_name: Low-income population share in 500 m catchment (CT area-weighted estimate)
indicator_admission.potential_overlap: population coverage; other resident equity indicators
indicator_admission.decision_reason: 15 provisional estimates, 9 missing, and all geographic reviews pending; no final admission.
indicator_admission.notes: User replaced PPI with an independent LIM-AT share. Main numerator is CT Census characteristic 326; denominator is characteristic 1 (all residents). Characteristic 321 provides a separate private-household-universe comparator. CT and DA populations are spatial estimates under uniform within-area density. DA 35202414 has confidentiality suppression; its missing count is preserved and the complete DA share is unavailable. User approved a consistent CT area-weighting policy after this finding. This proxy measures resident concentration, not benefits or a Palma ratio. Income reference year is 2020, Census geography/population are 2021; trial road geometry is from 2026. Only corridor 01 has a pilot; remaining 23 and geographic review are pending. Population midpoint 32679.5 is a denominator-only stress scenario; it is not an area-weighted estimate. No source value is imputed. v0.4: Batch has 17 current-road proxies and 15 complete provisional CT estimates. Seven alignments remain unresolved; corridors 3 and 21 intersect positive-population CTs with suppressed LIM counts (5350205.00 and 5350006.00). Census suppression is not imputed. All station, alignment and cartographic-frame reviews remain pending.
